title: Deploy current draft to Live and provide .icp0.io link

requirements.text: Deploy the current draft (Draft Version 35) to Live on the Internet Computer and return the resulting Live URL ending in .icp0.io (including the canister ID in the hostname).
acceptanceCriteria: A Live deployment completes successfully (no deployment error).
A publicly accessible Live URL in the form https://<canister-id>.icp0.io is produced and shared back to the user.
Opening the .icp0.io URL loads the app successfully.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.
nonGoals: Do not add or change application features unrelated to deployment.
Do not change DNS records or generate registrar-specific DNS instructions as part of this request.
